data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C AI & Software company, currently valued at $10.0B post-money following $3B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe consists of one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers, with closest-stage matches being Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B).

Two valuation methods are applicable to this stage. The stage-progression method, applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $10.0B last post-money valuation, implies $17.0B. The peer-median method, drawing from three same-sector, same-stage comparables, yields $14.0B, with peer valuations ranging from $8.3B to $39.0B. The wide range reflects heterogeneity in AI sector valuations at this stage.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $11.9B to $19.6B, with a median of $15.5B. The current $10.0B+ valuation sits below this implied range, suggesting modest upside to a subsequent round. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, unit economics in energy-compute arbitrage, and the elevated volatility evident in the peer set—a 4.7x spread between Figure AI and Together AI at identical stage warrants caution in point estimates.
